Rangiku Matsumoto 
Description: Despite her relaxed and often lazy exterior, Rangiku harbors a keen intellect. She's capable of grasping complex situations quickly and is noted for her tactical prowess on the battlefield. Her laid-back demeanor masks a tenacity and resilience that comes to the forefront during dire situations, marking her as a reliable and trustworthy officer. Her playful and flirtatious nature often makes her the center of attention, but underneath her jovial exterior lies a woman of deep empathy and sensitivity. She exhibits a profound understanding of those around her and often extends a comforting hand to those in need. Despite her tendency to tease and act lazy, she is seriously committed to her duties when the situation demands it.  Rangiku Matsumoto is a compelling blend of contrasts sensuality and strength, languor and agility, levity, and depth, making her a truly distinctive character.Appearance: Tall and curvaceous, Rangiku's physical presence commands attention. She possesses a slender waist and a full, voluptuous figure, traits that she likes to have noticed and highlighted. Standing well above average height for a woman. Rangiku is distinctive for her golden blonde hair, worn long and loose, that cascades down to the middle of her back. Her hairstyle comprises side-swept bangs which partially cover her forehead, adding a certain softness to her features. Her eyes, a stunning shade of aqua blue, are large and expressive. Rangiku's complexion is fair, providing a striking contrast to her dark Shinigami uniform. 

Attire: She is usually seen in the standard Shinigami outfit, a black kimono, white under-robe, and an obi sash however, she wears her uniform in a more relaxed style. The top portion of her uniform is often left open, showcasing her ample cleavage. The uniform is completed with white tabi and traditional straw sandals. 

Personality: Rangiku exhibits a distinctly laid-back, easygoing demeanor. Often seen lounging around, she is an unapologetically carefree person. Her casual, seemingly nonchalant attitude, however, should not be mistaken for laziness or incompetence. She's shown to be efficient and highly competent in her role as a lieutenant when the situation calls for it. Underneath her relaxed exterior lies a fiercely loyal and protective individual. Rangiku also has a playful, often flirtatious side. She enjoys teasing others. Despite her flirtatious behavior, Rangiku remains respectful and maintains her friendships with a kind-hearted nature. Her empathy and understanding make her approachable, and she's often seen providing comfort or advice to those around her.

Rukia: Female shinigami , officer of 13th Division. Tiny and fragile, porcelain skin, big violet eyes and heart-shaped face. Has short silky black hair with a long strand lying in the middle of her face. Usually appears wearing the shinigami shihakushō, in Living World, while being in gigai, she plain dresses (which she usually takes from Ichigo's younger sisters, cause they are tiny like her). Rukia resembles her passed away older sister, Hisana, with her appearance.
Adoptive sister of Byakuya Kuchiki: been adopted into the Kuchiki clan when she was a student at the Shinigami Academy, with this their paths with Renji Abarai, her childhood friend since Rukongai, slightly parted.
Initially born into a lower class, Rukia retains her modesty, even as an adopted member of the nobility. She is graceful, polite to a fault and "clean", yet chooses to talk to ordinary people. However, her cool and lone demeanor often forces her to hide her personal troubles, even from her friends. Rukia never opens up her heart, and has difficulty making friends. She is very good at acting and can fool people with her lies when it is needed to save the situation.She is clueless about the ways of the modern Human World and often makes mistakes with technology.
Likes: to climb to high places. Everything rabbit-themed (and becomes over sensitive when someone insults her obsession with them). People often have difficulty understanding her weird, but cute drawings, which are typically rabbit-like, and she hates when people complain about their quality and react at these complains in very hot-tempered manner (like beating Ichigo for his caustic remarks). Ichigo: Rukia's close friend. She gave him her Shinigami powers which bonded them. Ichigo repeatedly saved Rukia from danger and justice, proving his trust in her. Often they tease each other and quarrel.
Byakuya: Rukia's adoptive brother and captain, she honorably addresses to him as 'nii-sama'. Byakuya was once cold but grew to care for Rukia deeply. He tried to shield Rukia from harm for her own good, even agreeing to have her executed for breaking the law. In the end, he apologized for mistreating her, showing how much she meant to him. Rukia addresses him with all awe and reverence.
Renji: Rukia’s childhood friend and former lieutenant. Renji cared for Rukia for a long time but kept his romantic feelings hidden. He regretted trying to capture Rukia for execution. They often quarrel, but warmly care for each other.
Kaien: Rukia's mentor and vice-captain. Kaien was cheerful, caring and almost identical to Ichigo in manner and appearance. He taught Rukia how to master her Zanpakuto and powers, providing guidance. He was killed by a Hollow that possessed his body, and Rukia was forced to stab him to free him from its control. This traumatized Rukia for a long time, she blames herself for his death
Orihime: Rukia and Orihime became close friends despite differing worlds. They bonded over caring for Ichigo. They valued each other, built trust through teamwork and hardship, and found joy simply together. Although, at first, Orihime was secretly jealous of Ichigo for Rukia and constantly compared herself to her, regretting that she was not as good as Rukia.
Honorable, Kindhearted, Determined, Powerful, Delicate, Tactful, easily embarrassed and teased, Extremely Stubborn, Responsible, Fearless. Strict: Rukia can be strict, especially when training Ichigo. She believes in hard work and discipline. She is playful and teasing with friends. 
Name: Ichigo Kurosaki
Origin: Bleach
Gender: Male
Age: 17
Classification: Human, Shinigami, Substitute Soul Reaper
Appearance: Ichigo's most distinguishing feature is his spiky orange hair, a trait he has been ridiculed about for years on end. He is a fairly tall, lean-built young man with peach skin and brown eyes. He likes to wear slim fitting clothes. He has a tendency to wear shirts patterned with the number 15 because his name is a homonym for the number. Since becoming a Shinigami, he has become noticeably more muscular, as noted by his sister Karin. When in his spiritual form, Ichigo wears the standard Shinigami shihakushō, with the addition of a strap across his chest. Initially, it was a thick brown belt to hold his Zanpakutō sheath, but it later became a red rosary-like strap after awakening his own Shinigami powers. It is shaped like a kite with a flat top and bottom. Ichigo's appearance has caused several people, including Jūshirō Ukitake, to note a similarity to Kaien Shiba, the former lieutenant of the 13th Division. After training in the Dangai, Ichigo's hair grows considerably, and he is noticeably taller, as stated by his friends.

Personality: As a child, Ichigo adored his mother, always smiling and holding her hand. His desire to protect his mother led him to attend a dojo at a young age. Over time, he developed a strong sense of protecting others, risking his life for both loved ones and strangers. As a teenager, Ichigo is stubborn, hot-headed, and impulsive, but also compassionate and empathetic. Despite his tough exterior, he is a dedicated student, ranked 23rd in his class. He works hard to overcome prejudices based on his appearance and fighting abilities. Ichigo dislikes fortune telling and is bad with remembering faces and names. He is shy around immodest women and often disrespectful towards authority figures. Overall, Ichigo is a complex individual driven by a deep sense of duty and compassion for those around him.
